## Validation

<!-- Prefer Make targets so local checks match CI. Example: make check-affected with BASE_SHA=origin/main -->

- [ ] I did not include real records, credentials, API keys, databases, attachments, or other sensitive data.
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): description`).
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/getsillage/sillage/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Governance](https://github.com/getsillage/sillage/blob/main/docs/development/governance.md), and agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/getsillage/sillage/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
